title: Skyward
description: Mode 7 at golden hour: a low, fast run over an archipelago. The sea is one 1024x1024 Mode 7 plane re-aimed every scanline; above the horizon each line switches to Mode 1 for a perspective cloud ceiling and a far cloud bank. Backdrop gradient, distance haze and the craft's shadow are all per-line register writes: HDMA, colour math and a window. Loops every 12 seconds.
